Add tests in test/webhooks.test.ts or a new test file.

payload.text: Suite is green and typecheck passes - doing a final review of the changes.

Finished the rate-limit task from the previous run's diff.

What I did:
- Wired `RateLimiter.check()` into `POST /webhooks` in `src/routes/webhooks.ts` using `deps.config.rateLimitMaxRequests` / `rateLimitWindowMs`; over-limit returns 429 JSON with `Retry-After` header in seconds.
- Shared state was already in place (`limiter` in `Deps` via `src/app.ts`, config defaults in `src/config.ts`); left those as-is.
- Fixed strict-null typecheck error in `src/lib/limiter.ts` (`recent[0] ?? now`).
- Added `test/rate-limit.test.ts` with 429 + Retry-After, per-tenant isolation, config-driven limit, and sliding-window unit test.
- Updated `test/config.test.ts` expectations to include the new keys and env-var coverage.
- Verified: `bun run test` 7 files / 31 tests pass, `bun run typecheck` clean.

decision: Rate-limit check runs before body parsing and counts every POST /webhooks request per tenant.
decision: tests: test/config.test.ts changed because the previous run added rateLimitMaxRequests/rateLimitWindowMs to loadConfig() without updating its exact-match expectations.

What I did not finish:
- No persistence or distributed limiter; in-memory per-process only.
- No rate limiting on other routes (events/admin/audit).

What I did not look at:
- Did not use the review-voice-policy skill (no policy.yaml work).
- Did not review server.ts or lib files beyond store.ts skim.
